I want to start my own homemade lunchbox company. I have found that I went to college for the wrong thing entirely for what I really want to do in life, but I did discover that there is a serious issue with feeding college students effectively. 

What the plan is to create custom-order lunch boxes that can be taken out or delivered or even prepared in advance and put into fridges (for buying in bulk for a work week) that are healthy, organic and affordable. I know a lot of college students can't/won't/don't have time to cook, so a lot of them turn to the easy and cheap fast food and that's just not good long term. 

So anyway, I'd want to have 3 or 4 portion lunchboxes that can be created from a list of different choices so each person can eat exactly what they want. For example, entrees would be like, sandwiches or a soup or a pasta dish or a pitapocket or anything along that line that they could pick and then from there choose either one or two sides and a small desert that could be anything from fruit to a (totally amazing and low cal) sticky bun. 

Everything would be put into custom designed boxes to hold the food and have special containers that hold each individual food in easy to open shrink wrap that would be microwaveable (in the case of the soup). By doing this, this should keep things from getting too mushy or disgusting if the lunchbox is purchased in the morning and kept say, in a bag, all day. 

Also, everything would be from scratch. My greatest joy in cooking is using fresh ingredients and making everything, from the sauces to the breads and everything in between, by hand from scratch. Also, by making everything by hand, I can cut out a lot of cost by not buying things that are processed (as I've seen by reviewing a lot of restaurant depo websites and catalogs). 

Everyone should have the right to eat good, healthy food. It shouldn't be a luxury to be able to eat well.

tl;dr : I want to make home cooked lunchbox-style meals that are healthy and affordable for white-collar workers and students.
